properties.name: A user can see that reflow2 guided them through a principled process, rather than having to take it on trust
properties.statement:
A person handing reflow2 to someone else must be able to gain CONFIDENCE — from the design itself rather than from testimony — that the process was followed and that the result is a principled design rather than a functional mess.

DISTINCT FROM THE DECISION THE GUARD NAMED, and the split is the ordinary one this project makes: that node is the open QUESTION with its options, still `proposed` and unanswered. This is the INTENT — what must be true regardless of which option answers it. A Decision records a fork; a Requirement records the obligation. The decision can be settled several ways and this statement survives all of them.

ANTHONY'S WORDS, 2026-08-16, and the intent is his: "how can I gain confidence that reflow2 actually does proper systems engineering for another project if it doesn't do it for itself? when my brother uses reflow2 at his work, I want to be confident that reflow2 will guide him through proper systems engineering processes and that he won't end up with a web of features that, while functional, are a mess."

WHAT IS ALREADY TRUE, recorded so this is never read as "reflow2 has no process": THE GUIDED PATHS DO SEQUENCE FUNCTION BEFORE STRUCTURE. `genesis` seeds P0 Requirements and P1 Capabilities and then STOPS — "Do NOT create Components (P2) yet" — and lets `concept_without_design` ask the user how it should be structured. `adopt` runs five phases and forbids the central brownfield error outright: "never infer a Requirement from the implementation that satisfies it."

⇒ THE GAP IS NOT GUIDANCE. IT IS EVIDENCE. Nothing today records which skill a session worked under, at which phase, or reports when a design departed from the sequence — so "was he guided" can only be answered by asking him.

THREE CANDIDATE SHAPES, none chosen, recorded because the intent is clear and the mechanism is not:
(a) the design says which process produced it — record the skill and phase a session worked under;
(b) the loop reports departures from the sequence — "Components exist but no Capabilities", "allocated before anything was decomposed", "this boundary has no contract";
(c) the exposure is upstream of both — skills are SERVED but must be REACHED FOR, and `req:skill-use-survives-a-long-session` is accepted and NOT BUILT. A session that never loads `adopt` gets no guidance to evidence.

⚠️ WHY THE SELF-HOST IS NOT THE EVIDENCE ANYONE SHOULD USE, in either direction: reflow2 has no genesis epoch and was never taken through adopt. Its graph records organic growth with good bookkeeping, not a guided design. The strongest evidence available today is from CONSUMERS — music_graph's own report says "coverage_report is the single best thing in the adopt flow" and "unmotivated_capability IS the design-recovery engine, exactly as the skill claims". That is TESTIMONY, which is precisely what this requirement wants to replace with something checkable.

Lands `proposed`; only Anthony's word moves it.
